entries.title: Psalms 104:1
segments: ¶Give praise to the Lord, O my soul. O Lord my God, you are very great; you are robed with honour and power.

entries.title: Psalms 104:2
segments: You are clothed with light as with a robe; stretching out the heavens like a curtain:

entries.title: Psalms 104:3
segments: The arch of your house is based on the waters; you make the clouds your carriage; you go on the wings of the wind:

entries.title: Psalms 104:4
segments: He makes winds his angels, and flames of fire his servants.

entries.title: Psalms 104:5
segments: He has made the earth strong on its bases, so that it may not be moved for ever and ever;

entries.title: Psalms 104:6
segments: Covering it with the sea as with a robe: the waters were high over the mountains;

entries.title: Psalms 104:7
segments: At the voice of your word they went in flight; at the sound of your thunder they went away in fear;

entries.title: Psalms 104:8
segments: The mountains came up and the valleys went down into the place which you had made ready for them.

entries.title: Psalms 104:9
segments: You made a limit over which they might not go, so that the earth would never again be covered by them.

entries.title: Psalms 104:10
segments: ¶You sent the springs into the valleys; they are flowing between the hills.

entries.title: Psalms 104:11
segments: They give drink to every beast of the field; the mountain asses come to them for water.

entries.title: Psalms 104:12
segments: The birds of the air have their resting-places by them, and make their song among the branches.

entries.title: Psalms 104:13
segments: He sends down rain from his store-houses on the hills: the earth is full of the fruit of his works.

entries.title: Psalms 104:14
segments: He makes the grass come up for the cattle, and plants for the use of man; so that bread may come out of the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 104:15
segments: And wine to make glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face shining, and bread giving strength to his heart.

entries.title: Psalms 104:16
segments: The trees of the Lord are full of growth, the cedars of Lebanon of his planting;

entries.title: Psalms 104:17
segments: Where the birds have their resting-places; as for the stork, the tall trees are her house.

entries.title: Psalms 104:18
segments: The high hills are a safe place for the mountain goats, and the rocks for the small beasts.

entries.title: Psalms 104:19
segments: ¶He made the moon for a sign of the divisions of the year; teaching the sun the time of its going down.

entries.title: Psalms 104:20
segments: When you make it dark, it is night, when all the beasts of the woods come quietly out of their secret places.

entries.title: Psalms 104:21
segments: The young lions go thundering after their food; searching for their meat from God.

entries.title: Psalms 104:22
segments: The sun comes up, and they come together, and go back to their secret places to take their rest.

entries.title: Psalms 104:23
segments: Man goes out to his work, and to his business, till the evening.

entries.title: Psalms 104:24
segments: O Lord, how great is the number of your works! in wisdom you have made them all; the earth is full of the things you have made.

entries.title: Psalms 104:25
segments: There is the great, wide sea, where there are living things, great and small, more than may be numbered.

entries.title: Psalms 104:26
segments: There go the ships; there is that great beast, which you have made as a plaything.

entries.title: Psalms 104:27
segments: All of them are waiting for you, to give them their food in its time.

entries.title: Psalms 104:28
segments: They take what you give them; they are full of the good things which come from your open hand.

entries.title: Psalms 104:29
segments: If your face is veiled, they are troubled; when you take away their breath, they come to an end, and go back to the dust.

entries.title: Psalms 104:30
segments: If you send out your spirit, they are given life; you make new the face of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 104:31
segments: ¶Let the glory of the Lord be for ever; let the Lord have joy in his works:

entries.title: Psalms 104:32
segments: At whose look the earth is shaking; at whose touch the mountains send out smoke.

entries.title: Psalms 104:33
segments: I will make songs to the Lord all my life; I will make melody to my God while I have my being.

entries.title: Psalms 104:34
segments: Let my thoughts be sweet to him: I will be glad in the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 104:35
segments: Let sinners be cut off from the earth, and let all evil-doers come to an end. Give praise to the Lord, O my soul. Give praise to the Lord.
